sourceChecks.text: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:8で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:10で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:12で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:15で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:7で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:8で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:14で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:15で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA4:5で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! The LORD has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA4:8で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA4:12で本文がイシュ・ボシェテを名指す。
